national_helplines.name: National Emergency Response Support System (ERSS)
national_helplines.description: Unified single emergency number across India for Police, Fire, Ambulance, and Disaster Response.

national_helplines.name: National Cyber Crime Financial Fraud Reporting Helpline (I4C / MHA)
national_helplines.description: Call immediately if defrauded via UPI, NetBanking, Credit/Debit card, OTP, or phishing. Dial within 2-3 hours so authorities can freeze beneficiary bank accounts.

national_helplines.name: National Women Helpline (Police Crisis Assistance)
national_helplines.description: Dedicated emergency line for women facing domestic violence, stalking, workplace harassment, or street eve-teasing.

national_helplines.name: Childline India (National Child Protection)
national_helplines.description: Emergency phone service for children in need of aid, protection, rescue from child labour, or abuse.

national_helplines.name: National Consumer Helpline (NCH - Ministry of Consumer Affairs)
national_helplines.description: Government helpline for consumer grievances against fraudulent sellers, deficient services, overcharging, or refusal to refund.

national_helplines.name: Elderline (National Helpline for Senior Citizens)
national_helplines.description: Assistance for senior citizens facing elder abuse, property abandonment by children, or legal distress.

authorities.name: Delhi Police Special Cell - IFSO (Intelligence Fusion & Strategic Operations)
authorities.area_coverage: NCT of Delhi (Central, South, North, East, West, Dwarka, Rohini)
authorities.address: Special Cell, IFSO Unit, Sector 16-C, Dwarka, New Delhi - 110078
authorities.filing_instructions: Report online on cybercrime.gov.in or visit IFSO. Bring bank statements, transaction IDs, screenshots, and call recordings.

authorities.name: Delhi Police Headquarters (Central Control Room)
authorities.address: Delhi Police Head Quarters, Jai Singh Road, New Delhi - 110001
authorities.filing_instructions: Any police station must file a 'Zero FIR' if a cognizable crime occurred outside jurisdiction, then transfer it. File e-FIR on portal for theft/lost items.

authorities.name: Maharashtra State Cyber Police / BKC Cyber Crime Police Station
authorities.area_coverage: Mumbai Metropolitan Region (MMR), Thane, Navi Mumbai, Pune & Maharashtra
authorities.address: Bandra Kurla Complex (BKC) Police Station Bldg, Bandra East, Mumbai - 400051
authorities.filing_instructions: For financial scams, call 1930 immediately. Keep bank UTR numbers ready. File written complaint with transaction audit trails.

authorities.name: Mumbai Police Commissionerate (Control Room)
authorities.area_coverage: South Mumbai, Central Mumbai, Western & Eastern Suburbs
authorities.address: Mumbai Police Headquarters, Crawford Market, Fort, Mumbai - 400001
authorities.filing_instructions: Visit your local station (e.g. Andheri, Dadar, Colaba) or file Zero FIR if emergency. Approached if landlord disconnects electricity or uses goons.

authorities.name: Bengaluru City Cyber Crime Police Station (CCPS - CID Karnataka)
authorities.area_coverage: Bengaluru Urban, Whitefield, Electronic City, Koramangala, Indiranagar, Hebbal
authorities.address: CID Headquarters, Carlton House, Palace Road, Bengaluru - 560001
authorities.filing_instructions: Call 1930 to trigger the CFRMS portal freeze. Visit CCPS with complete email headers, URL proofs, and bank transaction slips.

authorities.name: Bengaluru City Police Commissionerate
authorities.area_coverage: All 8 Zones of BBMP / Bengaluru Urban
authorities.filing_instructions: Use the 'Suraksha' Karnataka police app for SOS. Walk into the nearest precinct for immediate non-cognizable (NCR) or cognizable FIR.

authorities.name: Telangana State Cyber Security Bureau (TSCSB) / Hyderabad Cyber Crime PS
authorities.area_coverage: HITEC City, Gachibowli, Secunderabad, Banjara Hills, Begumpet
authorities.address: CCPS, Detective Department, CCS Building, Basheerbagh, Hyderabad - 500029
authorities.filing_instructions: Telangana has special 1930 quick triage teams. Keep IFSC code, bank branch, and timestamp of debit SMS ready.

authorities.name: Uttar Pradesh State Cyber Crime Police Station / Nodal Cyber Cell
authorities.district: Gautam Buddha Nagar / Lucknow / All UP
authorities.area_coverage: Noida, Greater Noida, Ghaziabad, Lucknow, Kanpur, Varanasi, Agra
authorities.address: Cyber Police Station, Sector 36, Noida / Cyber Crime HQ, Signature Building, Gomti Nagar, Lucknow
authorities.filing_instructions: Use UPCOP mobile app to file e-FIR for lost property or online crimes. Dial 1930 or visit local Cyber Crime Thana.

authorities.name: Gujarat CID Crime Cyber Cell / Ahmedabad Cyber Police Station
authorities.address: Cyber Police Station, Police Bhavan, Sector 18, Gandhinagar - 382018
authorities.filing_instructions: Citizen portal 'e-GujCop' allows online tracking. Visit Cyber Crime Cell with bank dispute reference letter.

authorities.name: Kolkata Police Cyber Crime Department (Lalbazar)
authorities.area_coverage: Kolkata Metropolitan Area, Howrah, Salt Lake, Bidhannagar
authorities.address: Lalbazar Police Headquarters, 18 Lalbazar Street, Kolkata - 700001
authorities.filing_instructions: Submit formal complaint addressed to Joint Commissioner of Police (Crime), Lalbazar with transaction logs.

authorities.name: Greater Chennai Police Cyber Crime Cell
authorities.area_coverage: Chennai City, Tambaram, Avadi, Kanchipuram, Chengalpattu
authorities.address: Cyber Crime Wing, Commissioner Office, Vepery, Chennai - 600007
authorities.filing_instructions: Register on TN Police Citizen Portal or call 1930. FIR can be lodged at Vepery Cyber Crime Cell.

authorities.name: Rent Controller & Small Causes Court (Tenancy Redressal Authority)
authorities.area_coverage: All Municipal & Urban Areas under State Rent Control Acts
authorities.phone: Visit District Civil Court / Dial 112 if illegal eviction underway
authorities.address: Office of the Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM) / District Court Complex
authorities.filing_instructions: Send a registered 15-day Legal Notice first. If deposit not refunded or essential services cut, file petition before Rent Controller.

authorities.name: Office of the Labour Commissioner & Industrial Dispute Tribunal
authorities.area_coverage: Shops & Commercial Establishments, IT Corridors, Factories
authorities.address: State Labour Bhavan / Ministry of Labour & Employment, Shram Shakti Bhawan, New Delhi
authorities.filing_instructions: File complaint under Payment of Wages Act, 1936 or Industrial Disputes Act via online 'SAMADHAN' portal.

authorities.name: District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission (DCDRC - Consumer Forum)
authorities.area_coverage: Nationwide across all districts in India
authorities.address: District Consumer Commission Building in each District Court Campus
authorities.filing_instructions: Complaints up to ₹50 Lakhs are filed at District Forum. Use the e-Daakhil online portal to submit without hiring an advocate.
